description: This file defines a custom React hook named useActiveUsersTrend. The hook manages state and side effects related to fetching and displaying active user trend data from an API, supporting configurable parameters such as days lookback window and granularity (day/week). It interfaces with authentication and tenant context utilities, and exports an object with state variables, control functions, and metadata.

methods.name: useActiveUsersTrend({ days = 30, granularity = 'day' } = {})
methods.description: Hook to fetch and manage the active users trend state, with configurable options for days and granularity.
